items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 18 July 2026 11:34am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 18 July 2026 at 11:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Occasional strong wind at first.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred to the south of Iceland, with ridges to the Norwegian Sea and across Ireland to Britain.


##Wind##

Variable 2 to 4 in the east of the area, otherwise mainly North or Northwest 4 or 5 but occasionally 6 in places at first. Veering North or Northeast 3 to 5 in most waters overnight, decreasing 2 to 4 during tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling smooth or slight overnight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or Northeast 2 to 4, soon backing North or Northwest 4 or 5, and occasionally 6 from the North Channel to near the Isle of Man.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, soon becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
